cues.text: Let's manage your items and stock.
Open Inventory in the sidebar and choose Items. Each item shows its stock, price and a status.
Open Categories and add one. Vendors work the same way.
Press Add Item. Enter the name, choose the category and unit, and set the current stock, the minimum stock and the price.
Press Create, and the item appears in the list.
Use Stock Status to see only Low Stock or Out of Stock items, so you know what to reorder.
Press AI Suggest and choose a kind of school, such as Science Lab. Tick the items you want and add them in one go.
